rationale: The misspelling 'trand' is immediately readable as 'trend' from the surrounding 'trend watch trend watchers', so no meaning is changed.

The nonword 'cofer' is immediately readable as 'cover' in the phrase 'titanium cofer or just a plastic one', so no meaning is changed.

The quantity is changed from 11 to one, a clearly wrong count, but the utterance's main point (whether a remote control for everyone is feasible) is preserved; the reference '11 remote control' is grammatically odd, suggesting a possible transcription issue.

The budget figure '12.5 euro per' — the main point of the utterance — is garbled into '12 and the hall bura ber', so the specific price constraint is largely lost even though the general 'fits within ... remote' frame survives.
Deleting the trailing "ok" removes the speaker's request for confirmation, a slight change in meaning while the main proposition (decided on a rubber casing) stays intact.
Reading only the ASR sentence, the parallel structure "we have got the t b we have got the video" makes it clear the intended word is "tv", so no meaning is lost.

The modal/copula phrase 'would definitely be' is collapsed into the nonword 'definitelyb', losing the hypothetical framing and grammatical structure, but the core judgment ('a bad idea not to include teletext') remains recoverable.
Deleting the article 'the' before the quoted slogan does not change the meaning of the utterance.
The deleted span is a repeated 'it is not a it is not' false start/repetition that adds no new meaning, so removing it does not change the proposition.
The ASR spelling 'penila' is a trivial misspelling of the name 'pernilla', so a fluent reader still identifies the intended person and no meaning is lost.
The deleted "so" is a filler/discourse marker adding no meaning, so removing it does not change the proposition.
Deleting the filler 'ah' removes no semantic information; the proposition is unchanged.
The whole negative imperative 'do not all jump at once' is replaced by unrelated nonsense, so the main proposition is lost, though it is not a polarity reversal of a preserved proposition.

The one-letter difference in 'teletext' → 'teletex' is a trivial spelling variant; a fluent reader still clearly reads the intended service name, so no meaning changes.
Replacing the preposition 'with' by 'way' slightly garbles the clause linkage, but the speaker's main point (being worried about when he talked about this) remains intact.
The deleted 'you' is a repeated false start that adds no meaning, so removing it does not change the proposition.

The possessive/department designation "our d" is turned into the garbled "r are the", losing which department is meant, but the main point (the manufacturing department can deliver curved cases) remains largely intact.
The main verb 'scroll' is replaced by the real word 'scrawl', changing the specific action being negated while the overall structure and meaning of the suggestion remain largely intact.

The role name is garbled into 'us int face designers' and the auxiliary 'is' is lost, but a fluent reader still recovers 'user interface designer(s)' and the plan described remains intact, so only a slight meaning change occurs.

The deleted span is an abandoned false start that is repeated in full immediately afterwards, so no semantic information is lost.
The truncated form "basi" is still immediately readable as "basically", so no meaning is lost.

Deleting the conditional "if" turns a hypothetical clause ("if the inverted search says...") into a flat assertion, changing meaningful specific information while the overall gist of the utterance survives.
